description: Great, I understand you're looking for information on the Help Scout Inbox API 2.0. This API is the primary REST API for managing conversations, customers, and support operations in Help Scout. It supports OAuth 2.0 authentication and has a rate limit of 200 requests per minute per account. The API uses HAL+JSON format with embedded resources and pagination. Here's a quick overview of some key endpoints and examples for creating, updating, and listing conversations, as well as listing threads in a conversation. If you have any specific questions or need more details on any of these endpoints, feel free to ask! I can also provide more information on authentication, custom fields, and other features of the API. Let me know how I can assist you further.
